instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Music rights and publishing company managing a catalog of 5,000 songs across 200 songwriters and composers. Handling royalty collection, sync licensing for TV/film/advertising, and copyright enforcement. Seeking to implement automated royalty tracking from streaming platforms and AI-assisted music similarity detection for infringement monitoring. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Building Automated Compliance and Royalty Tracking System
opportunities.rationale: Automating royalty collection and implementing AI-assisted similarity detection is critical to scaling revenue and mitigating compliance risk given the high regulatory environment. This builds directly upon existing operational needs and requires formalizing data pipelines.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional task force (Legal, Finance, Tech) to map all required global royalty reporting standards.
Procure or develop initial Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for automated API integration with 2-3 major streaming platforms.
Define clear data governance protocols ensuring copyright compliance and jurisdictional data residency.
resources_needed: API access credentials from major digital rights aggregators
Budget allocation for platform integration layer
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual royalty reconciliation hours by 70% within 12 months.
milestones: Successful beta test with one major streaming partner (Q4)
Internal adoption and revenue calculation validation (Q1 next year)

opportunities.title: Institutionalizing Innovation Discovery and Funding (The 'Idea-to-MVP' Pipeline)
opportunities.rationale: To prevent the loss of valuable internal side projects, a formal process is needed to shepherd promising ideas from the 20% time policy into maintainable, funded MVPs. This institutionalizes learning and mitigates cultural risk.

first_actions: Standardize the pitch competition process: Mandate clear success criteria for seed funding approval (e.g., ROI potential, technical feasibility).
Create a formal 'Idea Intake' funnel that tracks project health and resource commitment.
Pair newly funded projects with an assigned Product Owner who reports progress quarterly to the core stakeholders.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in successfully deployed, institutionally supported MVPs from 0 to 2 per year.
milestones: Formalize and pilot the Idea Intake funnel (Q3)
Successful launch of first post-pitch MVP (Q4)
Integration of 'Idea Review' gate into annual planning cycle

next_steps.action: Draft a 3-year technology roadmap that explicitly links the €50M ARR target to required digital capabilities (e.g., data ingestion, AI services).
Hold a stakeholder workshop to revise the formal business case approval chain, reducing mandatory signatories for non-capital expenditure projects.
Formalize a partnership structure with a specialized legal counsel to monitor global music rights compliance and advise on the AI similarity detection system.

key_weaknesses: Cultural resistance to formal process changes, despite executive mandate.
Lack of defined ownership for the technology stack outside of current product squads (creating reliance on ad-hoc efforts).
Decision-making remains slow due to high dependency on multi-stakeholder committee approvals.

improvements: Successful implementation of squad-based tech structure and '20% time' policy has fostered a culture of internal experimentation.
The new CEO provides critical strategic alignment and urgency necessary to prioritize digital transformation.
Formal annual planning process exists, providing the framework for structured goal setting.
persistent_gaps: The core operational processes (e.g., payments, rights enforcement) are still highly manual or siloed, representing significant technical debt.
Stakeholder buy-in remains inconsistent; while the CEO supports change, functional leaders resist process changes that alter established roles.
Financial planning models lack granularity to accurately assess the ROI of incremental digital investments.
achieved_milestones: Established product-aligned technology squads and central platform team.
Implemented '20% time' policy, successfully fostering internal innovation efforts (e.g., the initial dashboard project).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has moved from an 'informal' state to a structured experimentation model, driven by new executive leadership and increased market pressure (competitor entry, churn). The focus shifts from merely identifying ideas to formalizing the execution path for high-impact automation and scaling.
